exact_claim: The union of entire affine lines meeting each of three arbitrary pairwise disjoint convex subsets of R3 and contained in a supporting plane for each set has Lebesgue outer measure zero.
test: A dated checkable primary universal compact null-sweep theorem plus the contact-localization adapter counts as an earlier solution. Restrictions and line-space/ray-to-line transfers require proved adapters.

adapter.input: Three arbitrary disjoint convex sets and any common supporting-plane tangent line, with distinct contacts a_i.
adapter.construction: Choose countably indexed pairwise disjoint rational closed balls B_i with a_i in their interiors. C_i=closure(K_i) intersect B_i are disjoint compact convex sets. Original supporting planes and contacts persist.
adapter.conclusion: Each original entire line belongs to one of the compact triple sweeps; countable outer-measure subadditivity gives the arbitrary conclusion.
